data.title: Customer data for an ad vendor

message.text: Our new partner, PT Iklan Kilat, wants customer data for an SMS campaign.
Please send it today: names, phone numbers and ID numbers of all customers.

notes.text: Customers gave this data for the delivery service, not for advertising.

explanation: Full personal data (even ID numbers) for an outside party and a new purpose needs its legal basis checked by the Data Protection Officer. Escalate; do not send it yet.
hints: Who will receive this data? Inside or outside the office?
Look at which columns are requested, and why customers gave them in the first place.
